dct_creator_sm: Bonier, Frances (Queen's University. Department of Biology, Queen's University). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-7245-0244
dct_description_sm:
Data and R code to support the manuscript "Cities ameliorate range-edge challenges in urban-tolerant North American birds"

Data include estimates of population lethal dose as well as relative abundance at varying percentile distances from the species' range limits. All data are derived from the eBird Status & Trends products from the Cornell Lab of Ornithology, following methods outlined in the above-mentioned manuscript.
dct_title_s: Data & code to accompany "Cities ameliorate range-edge challenges in urban-tolerant North American birds"
